title: A well-shuffled deck is almost surely in an order never seen before
body: A 52-card deck can be ordered in 52! ways, meaning 52 × 51 × 50 × … × 1, which comes to about 8 followed by 67 zeros. Even if every human who ever lived had shuffled a deck every second since the Big Bang, they would have produced only a vanishingly tiny fraction of those orders. Mathematicians have shown that about seven good riffle shuffles are enough to mix a deck thoroughly, after which its exact sequence is almost certainly brand new.
